ALTER TABLE `content_approvals`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `client_id` int NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `platform` varchar(100) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `brand` varchar(100) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `title` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `content` text NOT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `reasoning` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `stats` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `approver_name` varchar(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `approver_phone` varchar(20) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `feedback` text NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `approved_at` timestamp NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `rejected_at` timestamp NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `sms_approval_sent` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `sms_approval_sent_at` timestamp NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `created_by` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;
